create_automation: create a new automation with a prompt, model id, and rrule schedule for a user
search_automations: search a user's automations by name or prompt text with optional active or paused status filter
claim_due_automations: atomically claim due active automations for execution and reschedule their next run time
toggle_automation: toggle an automation between active and paused states and update its next run time
get_runs_by_user_range: get automation runs within a date range for a user joined with parent automation details
